root_cause_guess: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by N+1 SQL queries inside order serializer loop
reasoning: The recent git commit c84a1f modified order_serializer.py to query the shipping address for each item individually inside a for-loop. When bulk order requests (GET /api/v1/orders/bulk) arrived, each request fired hundreds of sequential SQL queries, consuming all 20 connection pool slots and driving Postgres CPU to 99%.

evidence.excerpt: ERROR [order-service] [db-pool] Pool exhausted: 20/20 active connections held by bulk order serializer

suggested_mitigation: Refactor OrderSerializer to batch-fetch all required shipping addresses in a single SQL query.
